description: Page block with text and proof side by side, stacked or in the theme's columns.

howToUse: Use it for each block of a public page: an argument with its proof, such as text next to an image, a demo or numbers.
Put the proof in `aside`. Use `layout="split"` for side by side, and `reverse` to alternate sides down the page.
On mobile the parts stack, and screen readers always read the text first.
alternatives: Data grids inside an app: Table or Card.

keyboard.action: Moves through the links and buttons of the section, in reading order.

props.name: layout
props.description: `split`: text and proof side by side; `stacked`: text above the proof; `columns`: the theme's column grid.

props.name: reverse
props.description: In `split`, puts the proof before the text on wide screens (zigzag). On the phone, the text comes first.

props.name: wide
props.description: In `split`, gives the proof more width.

props.name: aside
props.description: The section's proof or media (in `split` and `stacked`).

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Defines a string value that labels the current element.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Callback called when the value changes.
